title: Pass a mixin value
summary: A mixin can accept a value, so one recipe makes several kinds of frame.
introduction: A mixin can accept a value, so one recipe makes several kinds of frame. Your task: Give game an orange border.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for pass a mixin value

blocks.text: A mixin can accept a value, so one recipe makes several kinds of frame. A default is used when you leave the input empty.
Use Less 4 on your computer. Install Node.js first. Save examples as lesson.less, then run npx lessc lesson.less lesson.css. The browser loads lesson.css; this site does not build Less.
Read the code step by step

items: The `frame` mixin accepts a colour argument. An empty call uses the default colour in its definition.

blocks.text: The book has a navy border and the game has a green border.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use parentheses around the input. Write a colour value rather than a quoted CSS class name.
